description: Zona di protezione dell’acqua potabile (Drinking water protection area) is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by github.com. Il dataset "Zona di protezione dell’acqua potabile" viene fornito secondo il modello INSPIRE. Coverage: IT. Its keywords include Drinking Water, ANNEX III, Protection area, INSPIRE. The listing shows 3 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
